scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w packages/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.test: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run test:integration -w apps/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run db:seed -w apps/api
scripts.test:browser: npm run build -w packages/contracts && playwright test
scripts.admin:recover: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run admin:recover -w apps/api --
